_comment: NeurHL Tier-2 config #2 (ledger gm-c2). Motivated by config #1's observed overfitting: every seed peaked at ~epoch 5 then degraded (val 1.21 -> 1.53 by epoch 15) with 1.2M params against 2.4k-9.7k training games. Change = ~11x capacity reduction + stronger regularization + use the full 2008+ corpus. Architecture family, objectives, heads, protocol and gates are unchanged. Amendment A1: adds 6 rolling team-form ctx features (use_team_form).
early_stop: rolling-origin val within tune window, patience 10
calibration: temperature_on_outcome4, fit in train window only
